name: PeerPulsar
description: Open-source peer-to-peer world hosting for Minecraft 26.3 (required on both host and joiner) featuring UPnP, 3-engine UDP Hole Punching (RUDP, KCP, QUIC) with live network switch hints, Tunnel Relay, #KEY room invites, default-on Join Approval with per-guest OP/Kick controls, and configurable network services.
